keys.meta_title: 16 Personality Types Test: Free Jungian Type Test | CoreSkillAI
keys.meta_desc: Free 16 personality types test in the Jungian and Myers-Briggs style. 48 public-domain Big Five items give your four-letter type with a percentage for every letter. About 6 minutes.
keys.p16_desc: Find your four-letter personality type with a percentage for every letter, scored from public-domain Big Five items.
keys.p16_how1: 48 short statements. Rate how well each one describes you, from strongly disagree to strongly agree.
keys.p16_how2: Answer as you usually are, not as you would like to be. There are no right or wrong answers.
keys.p16_how3: You get a four-letter type, a percentage for each letter and a short description. Takes about 6 minutes.
keys.p16_start_desc: Find your four-letter personality type, scored from public-domain Big Five items that research links to each letter.
keys.p16_r_high: You react strongly to stress and setbacks and tend to worry more than most people.
keys.p16_r_low: You stay calm under pressure and recover quickly from upsets.
keys.p16_r_mid: You react to stress about as much as most people do.
keys.p16_near: At least one of your letters is close to 50%. That part of your personality sits in the middle, and the other letter could describe you almost as well.
keys.p16_disclaimer: Personality traits are continuous, so a four-letter type is a simplification. This test is not affiliated with the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI), a trademark of The Myers-Briggs Company, and should not be used for hiring decisions.
keys.p16_q6: Am hard to get to know.
keys.p16_q8: Am not interested in other people's problems.
keys.p16_q12: See beauty in things that others might not notice.
keys.p16_q18: Am indifferent to the feelings of others.
keys.p16_q25: Am filled with doubts about things.
keys.p16_q26: Wait for others to lead the way.
keys.p16_q33: Like to do things for others.
keys.p16_q34: Want every detail taken care of.
keys.p16_q42: Believe in the importance of art.
keys.p16_dE: You draw energy from people and activity, speak up readily and tend to act first.
keys.p16_dI: You recharge on your own or with a few people, take time to open up and prefer to think before you speak.
keys.p16_dN: You are drawn to ideas, patterns and possibilities, and enjoy reflection, art and abstract problems.
keys.p16_dS: You trust what is concrete and proven, and prefer practical facts to theory and daydreaming.
keys.p16_dF: You weigh decisions by their effect on people and notice how others feel.
keys.p16_dT: You weigh decisions by logic and fairness, and can stay detached when others get emotional.
keys.p16_dJ: You like order, plans and finished tasks, and decide early.
keys.p16_dP: You keep options open, adapt as you go and are comfortable with some mess.
